title: gstack-extend stage-runs row
description: One line of the local-only stage-runs.jsonl ledger that gstack-extend writes for a hand-run skill (source gstack-extend, rung 0). A row with schema_version must match the v1 definition; a row without it is a legacy row from a writer older than the version field. Rows from other producers follow their own contracts. See docs/telemetry.md#schema-validation.
$comment: The root names every allowed key; the v1 and legacy definitions constrain them. A row-shape or meaning change adds a new schema_version branch and keeps the existing ones; a release-only change does not bump schema_version. Readers pin a release or commit of this file, or vendor it.

stage.description: Skill name without the extend: prefix.

agent.description: Harness that ran the stage; null when unverifiable.

model.description: Model ID in the harness's own vocabulary; null when unverifiable.

effort.description: Effort level in the harness's own vocabulary; null when unverifiable.

rung.description: Always 0: a hand-run skill has no fallback chain.

started_at.description: UTC start at second precision; null when the start cannot be represented. The pattern is the writer's shape, not calendar validation.

duration_s.description: Session wall-clock seconds including human waits; never capped.

source.description: Writer label. The producer chooses it, so any caller writing it is indistinguishable from gstack-extend. Not related to the *_source fields.

schema_version.description: Row format version. Unrelated to the skill-usage v field and the start-finish protocol marker.

producer_version.description: Release in the VERSION file of the gstack-extend installation that constructed the row; null when that file was missing, unsafe or malformed. A retried row keeps the release that first constructed it.

evidence_source.description: Where the matching agent, model or effort value came from: flag (an accepted finish flag), detected (the harness's own markers or session log) or unknown (the value is null).

agent_evidence.description: A null agent has agent_source unknown; any other agent has flag or detected.

model_evidence.description: A null model has model_source unknown; any other model has flag or detected.

effort_evidence.description: A null effort has effort_source unknown; any other effort has flag or detected.

legacy.description: Rows from writers older than schema_version. route and entrypoint_raw are each optional and the v1 metadata fields are not allowed. Never fill defaults for them: an absent key is unknown and proves no particular older release.
